title: Ethiopian Papaya Juice
community: Ethiopian juice bars — the digestive fruit drink
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Papaya Juice — ripe papaya blended with water or milk, honey, and a squeeze of lime. The Rift Valley's most available fruit made into a silky, tropical drink. Often layered with avocado juice in Addis Ababa's famous multi-layer juice presentations.
longDesc: Ethiopian papaya juice is the morning drink of the Rift Valley — the fruit grows abundantly and is available year-round. Its digestive enzyme (papain) makes it particularly beneficial after heavy Ethiopian meals.
ingredients: 1 medium ripe papaya — peeled, seeded, cubed
steps: Blend papaya, water or milk, honey, and lime juice until smooth.
chefTips: Lime juice brightens the papaya's somewhat flat flavour.
Ripe papaya — orange flesh, yields to gentle pressure.
cookingScience: Papaya contains papain — a protein-digesting enzyme that survives into the juice. Papain has documented digestive benefits, which is why papaya juice is traditionally recommended after heavy meals in cultures where it grows.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopian Rift Valley papaya — grown in the warm lowlands year-round.
culturalNote: Ethiopian papaya juice is the fruit of the Rift Valley in a glass — the abundant papaya harvest of Ethiopia's warm lowlands, blended with lime and honey, is the simple, complete expression of a country that grows fruit of extraordinary quality.
